AP3 到 Illustrious Pixel Relay 高档工作流程

为我自己制作的玩具两阶段 ComfyUI 工作流程，使用阿尼玛预览 3创建基础图像，然后使用杰出的SDXL对其进行升级和完善。

主要思想是保持AP3专注于它擅长的方面：字幕跟随、场景设置和多角色交互。同时，它避免依赖 AP3 进行高分辨率扩散细化，因为其官方建议是保持在~1MP 范围分辨率较高时，图像质量可能会下降。

在此工作流程中，AP3生成初始基础图像。然后图像在像素空间中传递到第二阶段，其中高档模型处理实际的图像放大, 和杰出的 SDXL 重新绘制/细化放大的图像通过 UltimateSDUpscale。这避免了 AP3 超出其舒适的分辨率范围，同时仍然利用Illustrious 更强的高分辨率重绘、背景渲染和细节细化.

o.en:
AP3-to-Illustrious Pixel Relay Upscale Workflow

A toy two-stage ComfyUI workflow made for myself that usesAnima Preview 3to create the base image, then usesIllustrious SDXLto upscale and refine it.

The main idea is to keepAP3focused on what it does well:caption following, scene setup, and multi-character interaction. At the same time, it avoids relying on AP3 for high-resolution diffusion refinement, since its official recommendation is to stay around the~1MP rangeand image quality can degrade at higher resolutions.

In this workflow,AP3 generates the initial base image. The image is then passed in pixel space to the second stage, where theupscale model handles the actual image enlargement, andIllustrious SDXL redraws/refines the enlarged imagethrough UltimateSDUpscale. This avoids pushing AP3 beyond its comfortable resolution range while still taking advantage ofIllustrious’s stronger high-resolution redraw, background rendering, and detail refinement.
